equity.level_reason: Second-dose receipt is reported by race/ethnicity and racial shares of recipients are tracked over time, and the Discussion frames lower vaccination of Black and Hispanic persons as a disparity, but values are only set side by side with no computed difference or ratio, so the level is capped at 2.

level_alternative.reason: The Discussion frames Hispanic and Black persons as less likely to be vaccinated despite disproportionate burden and names access barriers; a looser reading treats the period shares as a quantified disparity.
